Dr. '''Zoltán Illés''' (born 17 January 1961)<ref name="Biography">{{cite web |url=http://www.parlament.hu/kepv/eletrajz/hu/i001.pdf |title=''Biography'' |publisher=[[National Assembly of Hungary|Országgyűlés]] |access-date=2012-11-21 |archive-date=2013-10-04 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20131004230834/http://www.parlament.hu/kepv/eletrajz/hu/i001.pdf |url-status=live }}</ref> is a Hungarian chemical engineer and politician, member of the [[National Assembly of Hungary]] (MP) for [[Terézváros]], 6th District of [[Budapest]] (Budapest Constituency VIII) from 2010 to 2014.<ref name="Register">{{cite web |url=http://www.parlament.hu/internet/plsql/ogy_kpv.kepv_adat?p_azon=i001&p_ckl=39 |title=''Register'' |publisher=[[National Assembly of Hungary|Országgyűlés]] |access-date=2012-11-21 |archive-date=2011-05-06 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110506213151/http://www.parlament.hu/internet/plsql/ogy_kpv.kepv_adat?p_azon=i001&p_ckl=39 |url-status=live }}</ref> He also represented Terézváros between 1998 and 2002. He secured a seat from [[Fidesz]] National List in the [[2002 Hungarian parliamentary election]].<ref name="Register"/>

He served as Chairman of the Committee on the Environment from 25 June 1998 to 14 May 2002. Illés was appointed Secretary of State for Environmental Protection and Water in the Ministry of Rural Development on 2 June 2010. He is also a meritorious student and received prestigious Fulbright - Humphrey Scholarship.<ref name="Register"/>

In September 2013, Illés responded to a formal question from [[Bernadett Szél]] ([[Politics Can Be Different|LMP]]) about the [[Roșia Montană Project]] in [[Romania]], where amongst other things he said "just because you’re pretty doesn’t also mean you’re smart," and lectured her for daring to utter the Prime Minister [[Viktor Orbán]]'s name. Later, Illés has apologized for these remarks.<ref>{{cite web|access-date=2013-09-25|url=http://www.politics.hu/20130912/fidesz-offers-apology-for-environment-ministers-sexist-remark-to-mp/|title=Fidesz offers apology for official's sexist remark to female MP|date=12 September 2013|archive-date=2013-09-27|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20130927150316/http://www.politics.hu/20130912/fidesz-offers-apology-for-environment-ministers-sexist-remark-to-mp/|url-status=live}}</ref> House Speaker [[László Kövér]] has defended Illés' controversial comments in parliament, referring to his fellow Fidesz politician’s words as "offensive, but not flagrantly offensive."<ref>{{cite web|access-date=2013-09-25|url=http://www.politics.hu/20130913/house-speaker-kover-defends-government-official-over-sexist-statement-to-opposition-mp/|title=House speaker Kövér defends government official over sexist statement to opposition MP|date=13 September 2013|archive-date=2013-09-27|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20130927150333/http://www.politics.hu/20130913/house-speaker-kover-defends-government-official-over-sexist-statement-to-opposition-mp/|url-status=live}}</ref>

As environmentalist, he strongly criticized the planned upgrade of the [[Paks Nuclear Power Plant]], signed between the Hungarian and Russian governments in January 2014. As a result, he was unable to run as parliamentary candidate for the [[2014 Hungarian parliamentary election|2014 parliamentary election]].<ref>{{cite web|access-date=2015-10-22|url=http://index.hu/belfold/2014/06/03/nem_lesz_allamtitkar_illes_zoltan/|title=Nem lesz államtitkár Illés Zoltán|date=2014-06-03|archive-date=2015-06-25|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150625135133/http://index.hu/belfold/2014/06/03/nem_lesz_allamtitkar_illes_zoltan/|url-status=live}}</ref> Since then, Illés accused Orbán's government in several cases with corruption and development of oligarchic system.<ref>{{cite web|access-date=2015-10-22|url=http://www.atv.hu/belfold/20150314-illes-zoltan-a-mohosag-utan-jon-a-bukas|title=Illés Zoltán: "a mohóság után jön a bukás"|date=2015-03-14}}</ref>

==Personal life==
He is married. His wife is Dr Adrienne Illésné Gerlényi. They have a son, Szabolcs.<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.origo.hu/itthon/20030207illes.html |title=- Illés Zoltán vagyonnyilatkozata - 2003. február |access-date=2017-11-09 |archive-date=2017-11-09 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20171109134912/http://www.origo.hu/itthon/20030207illes.html |url-status=live }}</ref>
